review_comments.body: **State removal lacks tests** The new tests only call the client methods, so they still pass if either new `RemoveResource` branch is deleted. This leaves the main refresh fix unprotected. Add `Read` tests for both permission versions that assert a 404 removes the resource without errors, while a 403 reports an error and keeps the state. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
